title: Composio Org API key (oak_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: OAK_ vs the documented lower-case oak_, prefix: oak- in place of oak_, and prefix: ok_, missing the a. Twin of "Composio Org API key (oak_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of composio-org-api-key-chat-paste: prefix: ok_, missing the a. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
